title: VeeReview: Measuring Build-Verify Pairs in Agent-Authored Pull Requests from a V-Model Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2610.29143v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Context: Reviewing a pull request requires verification evidence that addresses the proposed change. Coding agent benchmarks and studies of pull request outcomes do not directly assess this relationship. Objective: We test whether the V-Model's build and verify pairs can measure verification evidence in pull requests and support comparisons between agent-authored and human-authored changes. Method: VeeReview classifies four build and verify pairs using repository signals and a language-model judge. Three pairs use model judgements constrained by deterministic signals, and a rule over the diff and repository tree decides Module Design-Unit Test. We evaluated VeeReview against a 25-pull request reference set labelled by two raters and applied it to 1,454 matched pairs of agent and human pull requests from 741 repositories. translated_title: VeeReview：从V模型视角测量智能体创作拉取请求中的构建-验证对
translated_abstract: 背景：审查拉取请求需要针对所提议变更的验证证据，而编程智能体基准测试和拉取请求结果研究并未直接评估这种关系。目标：我们检验V模型的构建与验证对能否测量拉取请求中的验证证据，并支持智能体创作与人类创作变更之间的比较。方法：VeeReview使用仓库信号和语言模型裁判对四对构建-验证对进行分类，其中三对使用受确定性信号约束的模型判断，另一对则通过基于差异和仓库树的规则来判定“模块设计-单元测试”对。我们在由两名评估者标注的25个拉取请求参考集上评估了VeeReview，并将其应用于来自741个仓库的1,454对匹配的智能体与人类拉取请求。结果：VeeReview在所有四对构建-验证对上为智能体创作的拉取请求分配了更低的“仅构建”率，这与……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出基于V模型构建-验证对的VeeReview方法，通过仓库信号和语言模型裁判测量拉取请求中的验证证据，发现智能体创作的拉取请求在全部四个验证维度上的“仅构建”率均低于人类拉取请求，与普遍预期相反。
en_tdlr: VeeReview applies V-Model build-verify pairs, combining repository signals and a language-model judge, to measure verification evidence in pull requests, revealing that agent-authored PRs exhibit lower build-only rates than human PRs across all four verification pairs, contrary to expectations.
